title: What *should* go on a resume achievement... ✍️
description:
If your resume is packed full of every little job related thing you've done that ISN'T helping your chances of getting an interview. Recruiters only want to see the most relevant information that shows your value as an employee. How can you show this? Using keywords from the job description in achievements describing work wins. These aren't tasks. These are accomplishments that showed how you added impact in your previous role. #resumetips #resume #resumebuilder #jobsearch#jobsearchtips #jobinterview
